**Job Description:**
 Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro\-segmentation technologies—that protect east\-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4\) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team.
   

  

 Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever\-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting\-edge capabilities for
 **VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP)** 
 and the
 **VMware vDefend Firewall** 
 .
   

  

 Hosted on the
 **Security Services Platform (SSP)** 
 ,
 **Security Intelligence** 
 is a state\-of\-the\-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software\-defined Layer 3\-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro\-segmentation at massive scale.
   

  

 Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like
 **Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL** 
 to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Work On**
* Network Policy \& Micro\-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement.
* Datacenter\-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real\-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications.
* Metadata Ingestion \& "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes.
